title: True ending

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: They say when you hear your name in a dream, you wake up. Is your name Thaddeus?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They say when you hear your name in a dream, you wake up. Is your name Thaddeus?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: No. But he sent a message last night. I'll play it for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. But he sent a message last night. I'll play it for you.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: If you're getting this message, it means the process failed. I guess it was my time. Damn, I feel tired though. I just wanted to clear up some things before I shuffle off stage.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you're getting this message, it means the process failed. I guess it was my time. Damn, I feel tired though. I just wanted to clear up some things before I shuffle off stage.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: You uncovered more about my true nature than anyone else has for a thousand years. In any other epoch, I would have had you killed to protect those secrets. Now though, all I want is to scream them out loud for the world to hear.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You uncovered more about my true nature than anyone else has for a thousand years. In any other epoch, I would have had you killed to protect those secrets. Now though, all I want is to scream them out loud for the world to hear.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I hope we learn the truth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope we learn the truth.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I hope we learn the truth.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I hope we learn the truth.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: In another reality, our conversation stops now. But in this turning... well, you're smart kid, I'll give you that. You figured out a good deal more than I expected. Than anyone could have expected.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In another reality, our conversation stops now. But in this turning... well, you're smart kid, I'll give you that. You figured out a good deal more than I expected. Than anyone could have expected.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: But you went further than even I thought you could. Dug deeper. Turns out, all it takes to figure out the mystery of Thaddeus is someone who hasn't felt his influence, even when everyone else has.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But you went further than even I thought you could. Dug deeper. Turns out, all it takes to figure out the mystery of Thaddeus is someone who hasn't felt his influence, even when everyone else has.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Huck, Banor, Gunger, the donut kid, the old woman... everyone. Everyone. I gave my memories to everyone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huck, Banor, Gunger, the donut kid, the old woman... everyone. Everyone. I gave my memories to everyone.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Everywhere I look, I see my own ideas staring back at me, and the fools don't realize they all came from me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everywhere I look, I see my own ideas staring back at me, and the fools don't realize they all came from me!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: No. He sent a message last night. I'll play it for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. He sent a message last night. I'll play it for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can we believe him now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can we believe him now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's seems different.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's seems different.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We figured it out, Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We figured it out, Ava.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I knew it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew it.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Because, through all those generations and propagation, on account of nothing more than dumb luck, you were untainted by... me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because, through all those generations and propagation, on account of nothing more than dumb luck, you were untainted by... me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I always knew I was special!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I always knew I was special!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I always knew I was special!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I always knew I was special!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait! That made me his ... exit strategy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait! That made me his ... exit strategy?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wait! That made me his ... exit strategy?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wait! That made me his ... exit strategy?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So in the end I was little more than his tool to escape himself?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So in the end I was little more than his tool to escape himself?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So in the end I was little more than his tool to escape himself?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So in the end I was little more than his tool to escape himself?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: How about: You were his savior?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How about: You were his savior?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, Ava. I like that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, Ava. I like that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's bullshit, Ava!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's bullshit, Ava!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It seems... the process failed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It seems... the process failed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So I don't have Thaddeus's memories?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I don't have Thaddeus's memories?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So I don't have Thaddeus's memories?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So I don't have Thaddeus's memories?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The message origin is clear. It came from Sang-Ha. I believe he was there all along.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The message origin is clear. It came from Sang-Ha. I believe he was there all along.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: You might have put two and two together by now, and came out with infinity. Turns out, that answer is correct. I'm more than one person, more than a few. I passed memories - pieces of myself - on to Banor, Huckstash, Gunger and more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You might have put two and two together by now, and came out with infinity. Turns out, that answer is correct. I'm more than one person, more than a few. I passed memories - pieces of myself - on to Banor, Huckstash, Gunger and more.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I wonder who else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wonder who else.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Banor, Gunger, Huck - all of them couldn't tell you the truth, because my influence prevented it. Part of the condition of taking my memories, and a part of my personality, is that they cannot reveal the truth, even if they wanted to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Banor, Gunger, Huck - all of them couldn't tell you the truth, because my influence prevented it. Part of the condition of taking my memories, and a part of my personality, is that they cannot reveal the truth, even if they wanted to.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Those memories were no longer inside me, but they were close by, close enough to touch. And that kept me going... far longer than it should have. I always treated my friends well, as I hope I did with you too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Those memories were no longer inside me, but they were close by, close enough to touch. And that kept me going... far longer than it should have. I always treated my friends well, as I hope I did with you too.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Do you think he treated you well?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you think he treated you well?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: That's it. Thaddeus is gone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's it. Thaddeus is gone.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: To everyone but you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To everyone but you.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: When you've been around for as long as I have, you become attuned to your own influence. You can smell it. In a way, you're like my kids. All of you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When you've been around for as long as I have, you become attuned to your own influence. You can smell it. In a way, you're like my kids. All of you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But not me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But not me.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Of course! You're right. He traced someone untouched by his own memories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course! You're right. He traced someone untouched by his own memories.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: You're one of a kind. Not a metaphor there - just a fact. I dunno how I found you, but I knew you were the best candidate for my memories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're one of a kind. Not a metaphor there - just a fact. I dunno how I found you, but I knew you were the best candidate for my memories.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess he was dead wrong!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess he was dead wrong!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess he was dead wrong!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess he was dead wrong!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I wonder if he really wanted the experiment to work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wonder if he really wanted the experiment to work.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Everywhere I look, I see too much of me. Wherever I go next, even if it's into oblivion, I will be glad to get free from me. Goodbye kid. Thanks for showing me that this word has more to offer than just more Thaddeus.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everywhere I look, I see too much of me. Wherever I go next, even if it's into oblivion, I will be glad to get free from me. Goodbye kid. Thanks for showing me that this word has more to offer than just more Thaddeus.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm actually relieved. He's finally gone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm actually relieved. He's finally gone?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm actually relieved. He's finally gone?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm actually relieved. He's finally gone?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Even in death he tries to sell me something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Even in death he tries to sell me something.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Even in death he tries to sell me something.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Even in death he tries to sell me something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Guess I'm not entirely stupid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guess I'm not entirely stupid.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Touched by my memories and thoughts, going back through generations, back so far it's beyond the horizon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Touched by my memories and thoughts, going back through generations, back so far it's beyond the horizon.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that vanity?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that vanity?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that despair?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that despair?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Both.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Both.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How would he know that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How would he know that?

nodes.text: True ending
True ending
